<Heading
  as={"h1"}
  className={"openapi__heading"}
  children={"Record a physical cycle count for a bin"}
>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/bins/{binId}/cycle-counts"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Verifies a bin's physical contents against system records. If the counted quantity matches system quantity, records a clean CycleCountCompleted. A shortfall (counted &lt; system) marks whichever StockUnits cover the difference fully Unlocated (not split into located/lost sub-quantities — kept simple by design) and publishes ItemUnlocated per unit touched. An overage (counted > system) is reported as a DiscrepancyDetected/CycleCountCompleted(discrepancy=true) pair for a separate receiving/audit process to reconcile — this endpoint does not itself create the extra stock. Each call with a new Idempotency-Key represents a new physical count event and is intentionally repeatable (recounting a bin is a normal operational action); a retry with the SAME Idempotency-Key replays the first answer and counts nothing again (a first answer of 409 `concurrent-modification` is not stored: that retry executes).

What is NOT replayed: a 5xx, and every refusal that depends on state that can change, among them `concurrent-modification`, `bin-not-found`, `container-not-found`, `insufficient-usable`, `insufficient-reserved`, `bin-full`, `receipt-not-staged`, `container-not-sealed`, `container-not-stowed`, `hazmat-zone-required`, `temperature-class-mismatch` and `location-classification-unavailable`.
